parts.question_text: Define electric potential at a point.

parts.label: (b)
parts.question_text:
An isolated solid metal sphere of radius r is given a positive charge.
The potential at the surface of the sphere is 9.0 × 10^{4} V. At a distance of 3r from the centre of
the sphere, the electric field strength is 2.0 × 10^{5} N C^{-1}.
parts.question_text_latex:
An isolated solid metal sphere of radius r is given a positive charge.
The potential at the surface of the sphere is $9.0 \times 10^{4}\,\mathrm{V}$. At a distance of 3r from the centre of
the sphere, the electric field strength is $2.0 \times 10^{5}\,\mathrm{N}\,\mathrm{C}^{-1}$.

parts.label: (b)(i)
parts.question_text:
Determine the electric field strength at the surface of the sphere.
electric field strength = N C^{-1}
parts.question_text_latex:
Determine the electric field strength at the surface of the sphere.
$electric field strength = N C^{-1} $

parts.label: (b)(ii)
parts.question_text: Show that the radius of the sphere is 5.0 cm.

parts.label: (b)(iii)
parts.question_text:
Calculate the charge on the sphere.
charge = C
parts.question_text_latex:

parts.label: (b)(iv)
parts.question_text:
Use your answer in (b)(iii) to determine the capacitance of the sphere.
capacitance = F
